rows.medi_said: Review. What was the word for review?

rows.medi_said: الشمال روس بيكون آآآ برد كتير ويكون بيمطر أو بتثلج.

rows.english: in the north of Russia it is very cold and it rains or snows
rows.r3_why: A b- drop with no trigger, let pass; low confidence.
